citations.quote: Robert A. Bradway Chief Executive Officer and President
As disclosed in the "Summary Compensation Table" appearing on page 83, our CEO's annual total compensation for 2025 was $24,693,120.
The Board has fixed the authorized number of directors at 12 and we currently have 12 directors serving on our Board.

Eleven of our twelve director nominees (92%) are independent as defined by The NASDAQ Stock Market listing standards and the requirements of the Securities and Exchange Commission, with Mr. Bradway, our CEO, representing the sole exception.
In 2025, we received 94% stockholder support on our say on pay advisory vote.
Single Class of Shares. We have a single class of shares with equal voting rights. One share equals one vote.
